Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(virtualArray)
library(GEOquery)
library(Biobase)
library(limma)
library(affy)
library(R.utils)
library(dplyr)
library(sva)
library(plotly)
library(illuminaio)
library(data.table)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)

```
Download metadata full series.matrix file
```{r}
#Study 1
gse<-getGEO('GSE92324')
gse<-gse[[1]]
phenotype_data<-pData(gse)
geo_accession<- "GSE92324"
```
Download the datasets
```{r}
#Study 1:
gse_dir <- "<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE92324"
```
Unzip to gain full access to subject files
```{r}
idat_dir<-"<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE92324/txt_files"
```
Update phenotype conditions: clearly state "control" or "RIF"
- "title" is the column where the conditions are stated; check this to ensure it aligns with pheno column name
```{r}
phenotype_data <- phenotype_data %>%
  mutate(title = case_when(
    grepl("oocyte", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Control",
    grepl("failure", title, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "RIF",
    TRUE ~ title #(Keep original value if neither is matched)
  ))
```

read idat files
```{r}
# Get list of IDAT files from the corresponding directory
idat_files <- list.files(idat_dir, pattern = "\\.idat$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read IDAT files and extract intensity values
#1: create storage file where the data will be read into
raw_data_list <- list()
sample_names <- gsub("\\.idat$", "", basename(idat_files))  # Remove .idat extension for sample names
for (i in seq_along(idat_files)) {
  #2:read the files
    file <- idat_files[i]
    idat <- readIDAT(file)

    #3: create an if statement to ensure that the mean and code values are within each file
    if ("MeanBinData" %in% names(idat$Quants) && "CodesBinData" %in% names(idat$Quants)) {
        raw_data_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
          #4: read the intesity values and corresponding probe IDs into the storage list
            Intensity = idat$Quants$MeanBinData,
            Code = idat$Quants$CodesBinData
        )
        #5: fix column names
        colnames(raw_data_list[[i]]) <- c(paste0("Intensity_", sample_names[i]), paste0("Code_", sample_names[i]))
    } else {
        stop(paste("Required columns are missing in file:", file))
    }
}
```

Combine raw intensity data into one matrix (since they are all separate in the list object)
```{r}
combined_rawdata <- do.call(cbind, lapply(raw_data_list, function(x) x[ , 1]))  # Extract only intensity values (column one for each sample)
colnames(combined_rawdata) <- rownames(phenotype_data)
```

function to read the manifest (txt) file
```{r}
read_manifest <- function(file_path) {
  lines <- readLines(file_path)
  #Finds the line where [Probes] appears → this marks the start of probe annotation data
  probes_start <- which(lines == "[Probes]") + 1
  #Read the lines that follow as tab separated
  probes_data <- read.delim(text = lines[probes_start:length(lines)], sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
  return(probes_data)
}
```

Apply the function to read the manifest/txt file
```{r}
manifest_file <- "<original_archive>/MICROARRAY_DATA/GSE92324/GPL10558_HumanHT-12_V4_0_R2_15002873_B.txt"
manifest_data <- read_manifest(manifest_file)
# Extract Probe IDs from the manifest
probe_ids <- manifest_data$Probe_Id

```
CHECK: verify that CodesBinData from the idat files matches Array_Address_Id from the manifest file
```{r}
# Extract the probe-matching columns
idat_codes <- unique(unlist(lapply(raw_data_list, function(x) x$Code)))  # Get unique CodesBinData from IDAT
manifest_codes <- unique(manifest_data$Array_Address_Id)  # Get unique Array_Address_Id from the manifest

# Count how many match
matching_codes <- sum(idat_codes %in% manifest_codes)
total_idat_codes <- length(idat_codes)
total_manifest_codes <- length(manifest_codes)

# Print summary
cat("Total unique IDs in IDAT (CodesBinData):", total_idat_codes, "\n")
cat("Total unique IDs in Manifest (Array_Address_Id):", total_manifest_codes, "\n")
cat("Matching IDs between IDAT and Manifest:", matching_codes, "\n")

# Get the mismatches
idat_not_in_manifest <- setdiff(idat_codes, manifest_codes)
manifest_not_in_idat <- setdiff(manifest_codes, idat_codes)

cat("IDs in IDAT but NOT in Manifest:", length(idat_not_in_manifest), "\n")
cat("IDs in Manifest but NOT in IDAT:", length(manifest_not_in_idat), "\n")

```

Use the array_address_id from the illumina manifest file to match the probes with the codes from CodesBinData
```{r}
# Extract unique CodesBinData from IDAT (raw intensity data)
idat_codes <- unique(unlist(lapply(raw_data_list, function(x) x$Code)))

# Extract unique Array_Address_Id from the manifest file
manifest_codes <- unique(manifest_data$Array_Address_Id)

# Identify matching and non-matching probe IDs
matching_codes <- intersect(idat_codes, manifest_codes)
idat_not_in_manifest <- setdiff(idat_codes, manifest_codes)  # Extra probes in IDAT
manifest_not_in_idat <- setdiff(manifest_codes, idat_codes)  # Missing probes in IDAT

# Filter raw data to keep only matching probe IDs
filtered_raw_data <- lapply(raw_data_list, function(x) {
  x[x$Code %in% matching_codes, ]  # Keep only rows with matching IDs
})

# Convert list of data frames into a single combined data frame
totalcombined_data <- do.call(cbind, lapply(filtered_raw_data, function(x) x$Intensity))
rownames(totalcombined_data) <- filtered_raw_data[[1]]$Code  # Set row names as probe IDs
colnames(totalcombined_data) <- sample_names

# Ensure manifest data only contains matching probes
filtered_manifest <- manifest_data %>%
  filter(Array_Address_Id %in% matching_codes) %>%
  select(Array_Address_Id, Entrez_Gene_ID, Probe_Id, Symbol)  # Keep only necessary columns

# Merge the manifest and intensity data using Array_Address_Id as the key
final_matched_data <- merge(filtered_manifest, totalcombined_data, 
                            by.x = "Array_Address_Id", by.y = "row.names", all.x = TRUE)

# Display summary results
cat("Total Matching Probes:", length(matching_codes), "\n")
cat("IDs in IDAT but NOT in Manifest:", length(idat_not_in_manifest), "\n")
cat("IDs in Manifest but NOT in IDAT:", length(manifest_not_in_idat), "\n")

# View final matched data (optional)
head(final_matched_data)

```
normalize
```{r}
#Make sure to exclude any metadata when BC and normalizing
data_to_correct <- final_matched_data[, -c(1:4)]
# Background correction using the normexp method
bg_corrected <- backgroundCorrect(data_to_correct, method = "normexp", offset = 50)
log2_data <- log2(bg_corrected)
norm_data <- normalizeBetweenArrays(log2_data, method = "quantile")

```
quality control 
```{r}
boxplot(log2_data, main = "Normalized Data")

```

```{r}
boxplot(norm_data, main = "Normalized Data")
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,2))  # Split plots

# Raw Data MA Plot
plotMA(bg_corrected, main = "MA Plot: Raw Data", col = "red")

# Normalized Data MA Plot
plotMA(norm_data, main = "MA Plot: Normalized Data", col = "blue")

```
**after checking, create the final dataset to use for DE analysis
```{r}
final_data <- cbind(final_matched_data[, 1:4], norm_data)
```

final mean values for repeated symbols (merge probes looking at the same gene)
```{r}
merge_by_symbol <- function(data) {
  # Identify columns with expression data
  expression_cols <- setdiff(colnames(data), c("Array_Address_Id", "Entrez_Gene_ID", "Probe_Id", "Symbol"))
  
  # Group by Symbol and calculate mean for expression columns
  data %>%
    group_by(Symbol) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(expression_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Symbol) & Symbol != "") # Remove rows with NA or empty gene symbols
}

# Apply the function to your data
merged_data <- merge_by_symbol(final_data)

# Check for any rows without gene symbols
missing_symbols <- sum(is.na(merged_data$Symbol) | merged_data$Symbol == "")
cat("Number of rows without gene symbols:", missing_symbols, "\n")

```
finalize format
```{r}
#set the symbol column as row names
merged_data <- merged_data %>% column_to_rownames("Symbol")
colnames(merged_data) <- rownames(phenotype_data)
```

```{r}
# Compute PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(merged_data), scale. = TRUE)

# Convert to data frame
pca_data <- data.frame(PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2], Condition = phenotype_data$title)

# PCA plot
ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot: Normalized Data", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_minimal()

```
3D PCA
```{r}
# Compute PCA
pca <- prcomp(t(merged_data), scale. = TRUE)

# Extract the first three principal components and combine with sample metadata
pca_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  PC3 = pca$x[, 3],
  Condition = phenotype_data$title
)

# Calculate the percentage of variance explained by each component
var_exp <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:3] * 100

fig <- plot_ly(
  data = pca_data,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~Condition,
  colors = c("red", "blue"),
  marker = list(size = 5),
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers"
)

# Customize axis labels to display variance explained
fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 2), "%)")),
      yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 2), "%)")),
      zaxis = list(title = paste0("PC3 (", round(var_exp[3], 2), "%)"))
    )
  )

# Display the figure
fig

```
DE Analysis
Step 1: create design matrix
```{r}
group<-factor(phenotype_data$title, levels = c("Control","RIF"))
levels(group) <- make.names(levels(group))
#Design model matrix
design<-model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
rownames(design) <- colnames(merged_data)
colnames(design) <- c("Control", "RIF")
```
Step 2: fit linear model to the data
```{r}
fit <- lmFit(merged_data, design)
```
Step 3: define contrast matrix
```{r}
contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Control_vs_RIF = Control - RIF,
  levels = design
)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
```
Step 4: apply eBayes moderation
```{r}
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)
```
Step 5: find the top genes
```{r}
top_genes <- topTable(fit2, coef = "Control_vs_RIF", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")
#apply filter
de_genes <- top_genes[top_genes$adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(top_genes$logFC) > 1, ]
```

heat map
```{r}
# Subset merged_data for the DE genes
de_gene_ids <- rownames(de_genes)
heatmap_data <- merged_data[de_gene_ids, ]

#Scale each row (gene) to mean=0 and sd=1 to emphasize relative differences
scaled_heatmap_data <- t(scale(t(heatmap_data)))

# Create a column annotation data frame using the sample condition information
annotation_col <- data.frame(Condition = phenotype_data$title)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(merged_data)

# Create the heatmap
pheatmap(scaled_heatmap_data,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "complete",
         main = "Heatmap of Differentially Expressed Genes")

```
